name: Apex Composites
blurb: Apex Composites has been our title partner since 2023. They autoclave-cure our monocoque and both wing assemblies, and their laminate engineers sit in on every structural design review.
contribution: Carbon fibre monocoque and aerodynamic surfaces, plus laminate design mentoring.

name: Meridian Motorsport
blurb: Meridian supply the damper package and give us two days a season on their seven-post rig — the single biggest step change in our vehicle dynamics programme.
contribution: Adjustable dampers, seven-post rig time and suspension setup support.

name: Northgate Precision
blurb: Five-axis machining for our uprights, hubs and steering rack components, turned around inside a fortnight when we need it.
contribution: Five-axis CNC machining of suspension and steering components.

name: Halden Analytics
blurb: Halden fund our telemetry hardware and run a data-engineering workshop for the electronics subteam each October.
contribution: Telemetry hardware budget and an annual data engineering workshop.

name: Cartwright Fabrication
blurb: TIG welding of the rear subframe and impact structure, donated at cost, with IMechE-compliant weld inspection documentation.
contribution: Welding, fabrication and weld inspection sign-off.
